scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run update:release && git add -A && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git commit -m "v$VERSION" && git tag "v$VERSION"
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run update:release && git add -A && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git commit -m "v$VERSION" && git tag "v$VERSION"
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run update:release && git add -A && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git commit -m "v$VERSION" && git tag "v$VERSION"
